annotations.title: Look up US import records (importers, suppliers, bills of lading)

description: US customs sea import records for a US importer or an overseas supplier: total and last-12-month shipments with the trend, its suppliers (or a supplier's US customers) with shipments, weight and HS codes, products, source countries, ports and carriers, recent bills of lading, and lookalike importers that buy from the same factories. Use for sourcing, supplier discovery, importer prospecting and supply-chain research. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/us-import-records on your Apify account (about $0.004 per company profile, $0.001 per supplier or customer; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

companies.description: US importers by name or importyeti.com link, e.g. ["Allbirds"].

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

find_lookalikes.description: Add other US importers that use the same suppliers.

include_partners.description: Add one row per supplier (or customer).

include_shipments.description: Add the most recent bills of lading.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 100, max 5000). Cost scales with this.

max_partners_per_company.description: Most suppliers or customers per company.

shipped_within_days.description: Only shipments in the last N days.

suppliers.description: Overseas suppliers (factories) by name or link, to see their US customers.

name: search_import_records

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.
